source_observation.voice_output_packet_canonical_identity: VoiceOutputPacket.sha256() hashes the full as_dict() representation, including schema/classification and monotonic_ms, planned_audio_duration_ms, first_output_ms, cancellable, interruption_ms and voiceoutcome_ref.
source_observation.wp717_heard_material_projection: _heard_material() intentionally excludes voiceoutcome_ref to avoid the VoiceOutcome/result digest cycle, but it also excludes monotonic_ms, planned_audio_duration_ms, first_output_ms, cancellable, interruption_ms, schema and classification.
source_observation.current_heard_result_identity: HeardResultPayload binds packet_id plus SHA256(_heard_material(packet)), not the canonical pre-close VoiceOutputPacket identity.
source_observation.risk: Two distinct valid canonical VoiceOutputPacket values can differ in an omitted non-voiceoutcome_ref field while producing the same WP717 heard-material digest and therefore the same heard-result payload identity. This is narrower than a text-boundary/order collision: it is an identity-collapse between distinct accepted packet payloads.

candidate_counterexample.setup: Construct two otherwise-identical fully-heard commit-eligible VoiceOutputPacket values with the same session_id, turn_id, packet_id, sequence, text_segment, expression_intent and speech_act, but change exactly one omitted field such as planned_audio_duration_ms or first_output_ms while voiceoutcome_ref remains pre-close/unbound.
candidate_counterexample.expected_canonical_fact: VoiceOutputPacket.sha256() differs because the canonical packet payload differs.
candidate_counterexample.suspected_wp717_behavior: build_heard_result() produces the same ordered_output_material_sha256 and the same heard-result payload_sha256 for both packet variants because the changed field is outside _heard_material().
candidate_counterexample.promotion_risk: A stale or substituted packet payload could satisfy the same heard-result identity even though it is not the exact canonical packet payload whose identity the integration boundary claims to bind.

required_discriminator: Add a regression that mutates each canonical pre-close VoiceOutputPacket field not semantically derived from VoiceOutcome one at a time. For every field that is declared part of exact packet identity, the admitted heard-result identity MUST change or the substitute MUST fail closed. In particular, planned_audio_duration_ms/first_output_ms mutation must not remain identity-equivalent if the contract claims exact full VoiceOutputPacket payload binding.
required_resolution_options: Preferred if exact packet identity is intended: define an explicit versioned PRE_CLOSE_OUTPUT_PACKET_IDENTITY projection equal to the canonical VoiceOutputPacket payload with voiceoutcome_ref normalized/excluded solely to break the result/outcome cycle, while retaining every other canonical packet field plus schema/classification; hash and bind that projection.

If only semantic heard-content identity is intended: explicitly narrow the WP717 contract/receipt language to a versioned semantic heard-content projection and stop claiming exact/full VoiceOutputPacket payload identity; separately preserve canonical packet SHA/phase evidence where exact packet provenance is required.

relationship_to_existing_falsifiers.not_duplicate_of_digest_cycle: The existing pre/post-close digest-cycle falsifier concerns voiceoutcome_ref phase recursion. This finding accepts excluding/normalizing voiceoutcome_ref but questions the additional omission of unrelated canonical packet fields.
relationship_to_existing_falsifiers.not_duplicate_of_output_order: The existing output-order falsifier concerns semantic sequence versus lexical packet-ref order. This finding reproduces with one packet and therefore survives perfect ordering.
relationship_to_existing_falsifiers.not_duplicate_of_iterable_backlink: The existing iterable falsifier concerns a second-pass backlink check bypass. This finding reproduces with an immutable tuple and a valid backlink once the outcome is closed.

next_exact_action: The active WP717 mutation owner should execute the one-field packet-identity discriminator before repository acceptance. If reproduced and exact full-packet identity is the intended boundary, repair the canonicalization by binding an explicit pre-close full-packet identity that excludes/normalizes only voiceoutcome_ref, then rerun VSR01-VSR06 plus the existing order/cycle/iterable/close-turn falsifiers. Only after repository closure should the identical accepted source be exercised on the VPS sandbox for higher-tier evidence.
